item.title: Gate Change for the Istanbul Flight
item.summary: An airport announcement about a gate change, a short delay and the order in which passengers will board.
item.transcript_text: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen. This is an announcement for passengers on flight two seven one to Istanbul. Please note that this flight will now leave from gate fourteen, not gate nine. We're sorry, but there is also a short delay. The plane arrived late, and it needs to be cleaned and checked. The new departure time is ten past four. Boarding will start at half past three. Passengers with small children and anyone who needs extra help will board first. After that, we will call passengers by seat rows, starting with rows twenty to thirty-two. Please have your boarding pass and passport ready. Remember that each passenger can take only one small bag into the cabin. Thank you for your patience, and have a pleasant flight.
